name: Cylindrical Symmetry Projector
definition: A forward/back projector pair for objects with cylindrical symmetry. The Abel Transform is a special case of this applied to parallel-beam geometries.
summary: The Cylindrical Symmetry Projector, or Abel Transform, computes line integrals for axisymmetric volumes by reducing 3D integration to 1D, offering efficiency over general 3D projectors.
